title: The Philosophy of Time: Why APEX Watches Are Different
excerpt: We believe a watch is not a status symbol — it is a daily companion. Here is why we built APEX the way we did.
content:
At APEX, we started with a simple question: why do premium watches cost ₹5 lakhs when the components that make a watch truly great — sapphire crystal, real automatic movement, 316L steel — can be sourced for a fraction of that?

The answer is brand tax. A luxury watch charges you 90% for the name on the dial and 10% for the watch itself.

We inverted that ratio. APEX puts 85% of your money into the watch and 15% into building a brand worth wearing.
author: APEX Editorial

title: How to Read Your Watch Like a Connoisseur
excerpt: From dial finishing to movement architecture — a beginner's guide to watch appreciation.
content:
The difference between a ₹500 watch and a ₹9,000 watch is rarely the movement alone. It lives in the details: the depth of the dial colour, the crispness of the applied indices, the heft of the case in hand.

In this guide, we walk you through exactly what to look for when evaluating any timepiece.
author: APEX Editorial

title: Caring for Your APEX Timepiece: A Complete Guide
excerpt: A well-maintained watch lasts a lifetime. Here is everything you need to know.
content:
Your APEX watch is built to last decades. With minimal care, it will outlive every smartphone you will ever own. Here is how to keep it performing at its best.

Cleaning

Wipe the case monthly with a soft microfibre cloth. For the bracelet, a soft brush with mild soap and warm water works perfectly.

Servicing

Automatic movements should be serviced every 5–7 years. Our service centre can handle any APEX timepiece.
author: APEX Editorial
